name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.178: A drifting subtitle was refused - "no single offset is valid, left as downloaded" -
    which was right about the average and wrong about the conclusion. The segments the drift gate
    already found ARE the repair: each cue is now shifted by the offset of its OWN segment, a
    staircase. Over the 36 drifting episodes of this library the worst single-cue residual falls
    from a 10.74 s median to 4.51 s, 33 of 36 better, and a permutation test puts the staircase 14x
    better on the real ordering than on a shuffled one, so the steps are structure and not
    overfitting. Two of the 36 come out worse and no reference-free signal separates them from the
    33, so the anchor path wins when a same-language reference exists and the untouched original is
    kept either way. The order guard is the mirror of the anchor path's: the staircase ADDS its
    shift, so it is bounded from below - with the sign reversed it left a 1.92 s residual and
    guarded 22 cues instead of 6.
